changeSummary: Added a machine-readable scene-wide metadata coverage contract for Ground, Danchi, ParkEntrance, Trees, StreetFurniture and optional ArtSlots replacement content.

Each domain now records manufacture, dimensions/thickness, materials/finish, mounting, interfaces/gaps/seals, orientation/exposure, causal aging, geometry-vs-material responsibility, LOD policy and links to detailed QA contracts.

Added active-renderer coverage QA: every enabled renderer beneath QualityBlock1990s must inherit exactly one registered direct scene-domain scope; unregistered renderer roots, missing/null materials or missing shaders fail validation.

Added a persisted scene-save gate so later saves of the canonical quality scene cannot introduce unregistered rendered content. Initial unsaved-scene creation is deliberately exempt to avoid sceneSaving re-entry; the subsequent persisted quality-chain saves are gated.
Bound metadata contract validation and active-renderer coverage validation into the Complete Native 4K Review Packet before any visual score can be reviewed.

implementationReadiness.reason: The only existing weighted readiness blocker remains actual Unity compile verification. This run closes a critical metadata-coverage loophole but does not fabricate runner evidence or visual points.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Geometry & construction fidelity: reduces the risk that newly introduced rendered assemblies bypass manufacture, thickness, mounting and interface reasoning required for the 18/20 hard minimum.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: every active renderer is now forced into a domain whose linked contracts define physical material families and angular response; missing/null material bindings are rejected before review.
Weathering/context causality: each rendered domain explicitly records exposure and aging causes, reducing future arbitrary grime/damage additions that would threaten the 9/10 hard minimum.

Vegetation/natural complexity: tree/understory renderers inherit biological construction, root-ground interfaces and ordinary maintenance/exposure metadata instead of being able to enter as unregistered decorative geometry.
Period accuracy/scene authenticity: replacement-slot content cannot bypass period/construction contracts merely by being parented under ArtSlots.

Critical-defect risk: directly addresses missing required construction/material metadata by making an uncovered active benchmark renderer a save/review-packet failure. This source-side closure does not clear the critical defect visually without a real render.

visualFidelity.reason: No Unity-generated 3840x2160 stills, pixel-exact 100% crops or sealed temporal sequences exist. Source metadata coverage cannot be converted into visual points.
